narr: A cold front had pushed into West Texas. Modest wind shear was across far West Texas. The Davis Mountains provided a good source of elevated heating and lift. Fairly high moisture and instability were across the area. These conditions resulted in heavy rain that produced flash flooding in Reeves County.
ev: Heavy rain fell across Reeves County and resulted in flash flooding near Balmorhea. There was a high water rescue. A person in a pickup drove through a low water crossing south of Balmorhea Lake. The pickup and driver were washed 1000 feet downstream. The cost of damage is a very rough estimate.
lsr: HIGH WATER RESCUE. PICKUP DRIVEN THROUGH LOW WATER CROSSING SOUTH OF BALMORHEA LAKE. PICKUP AND DRIVER WASHED 1000 FT DOWNSTREAM.
